info.name: Booking System - Integration Tests (Use Cases UC-1 to UC-16)
info.description:
Integration tests for the appointment booking system, driven through the GraphQL API at {{baseUrl}}. Each folder covers one use case from the SRS; each request is one numbered integration test (IT-xx) that exercises a complete workflow across the API, services and database, and asserts the resulting state change.

RUN ORDER MATTERS. Use the Collection Runner (or newman) and run the whole collection top to bottom: later tests reuse the accounts, business, services, slots and bookings created by earlier ones. Every run creates its own data using a unique {{stamp}}, so runs do not collide with each other.

Prerequisites: the Go server running and reachable at {{baseUrl}}, pointed at a disposable test database. These tests create real accounts, a real business and real bookings.

exec: // Dates are worked out in LOCAL time, not UTC: the server compares them
// against its own clock, so before 08:00 in a UTC+8 timezone the UTC date is
// still yesterday, which would put "today" in the past and fail the run.
// The weekly series repeats on whatever weekday falls 14 days out, so the
// run never depends on which day of the week it happens to start.
